all.source_quote: Studying in a recognized school (generally Class 9 - 10 for SC/ST/OBC schemes; Class 1–10 in some variants)
Must be a regular/full-time student enrolled in school

unmodelled.text: Must belong to SC, ST or OBC community and possess a valid caste certificate
unmodelled.source_quote: Must belong to SC/ST/OBC community and possess a valid caste certificate.

unmodelled.text: Annual family income limit not exceeding Rs 2.5 lakh for SC/ST (slightly higher for OBC depending on state)
unmodelled.source_quote: Annual family income limit should not exceed: Rs 2.5 lakh for SC/ST students (varies slightly for OBC depending on scheme/state).

unmodelled.text: Must not be availing another scholarship for the same purpose
unmodelled.source_quote: Only one scholarship at a time: Student should not be availing another scholarship for the same purpose.

unmodelled.text: Must belong to the state/UT from where applying (domicile requirement)
unmodelled.source_quote: Domicile requirement: Must belong to the state/UT from where applying.
